passages.text: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has servants.
Servants of the LORD must praise Him.
Praise the LORD.
Praise the name of the LORD.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
His name is holy.
May the name of the LORD be blessed.
Let His name be blessed now.
Let His name be blessed forever.
passages.original: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has a name.
People praise the name of the LORD.
People praise Him everywhere.
People praise Him from the place where the sun rises.
People praise Him to the place where the sun sets.
passages.original: מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־ מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
passages.sermon: The LORD is exalted.\r\nHe is above all nations.\r\nHis glory is above the heavens.
passages.original: רָ֖ם עַל־ כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
passages.sermon: The LORD is our God.\r\nHe sits enthroned on high.\r\nNo one is like Him.

passages.text: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is exalted over all nations.
His glory is above the heavens.
The LORD is our God.
He sits enthroned on high.
The LORD humbles Himself.
He looks down to see the heavens.
He looks down to see the earth.

passages.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He is enthroned on high.
He raises the poor from the dust.
He lifts the needy from the garbage heap.
He seats the poor with nobles.
He places the needy with the princes of His people.
passages.original: מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃ לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם־ נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and compassion.
God gives a home to the barren woman.
God makes her a joyful mother.
She has children.
Praise the Lord!
passages.original: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־ הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
